title: ARGUS order-block survival research verified
summary: ARGUS now converts confirmed terminal order-block lifecycles into retrospective survival-study records and estimates Kaplan-Meier survival with INVALIDATED as the event and EXPIRED as right-censoring. The research layer reports at-risk/event/censor counts, survival probability, observed median survival, restricted mean survival, evidence-tier strata, and explicitly retrospective final-test-count strata. It does not claim profitability, causal predictive power, statistical significance, stationarity, transferability, or production readiness.
